adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the diff appends HTML containing an anchor built via string interpolation: `contents << "...#{url}..."`. The only validation shown is `return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`, which would still allow quotes and other characters that can break out of the single-quoted `href` attribute (e.g., `http://host/x' onmouseover='...`). Because imported posts are created with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and later rendered with `raw post.cooked` in `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`, this becomes a real HTML attribute injection/XSS risk grounded in the diff.
